title: Dreaming in Felt
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Tender felt-piano chords float over a swung broken kick before blooming into a bright, sidechained supersaw chorus with a chopped vocal hook. The arc climbs to a glossy peak, dips into a dreamy beatless valley, then lifts higher into a second, fuller chorus before a soft outro.
code:
